nodes.question: What challenges does the proposed method aim to tackle in the context of UDA?
nodes.answer: The proposed method aims to tackle the challenge of integrating high-performing yet computationally expensive models with faster but less accurate models, and to effectively combine models from easier tasks into harder tasks, resulting in performance gains without incurring additional training costs.
